title: Complimentary Upgrade Entitlements by Summit Tier
content:
Crestline Summit Loyalty Program members hold different complimentary upgrade entitlements according to tier.

| Tier | May request complimentary upgrades | Complimentary requests begin to clear (hours before scheduled departure) | Clearance priority rank (1 clears first) | One companion on the same reservation upgraded with the member | Complimentary and certificate upgrades on award tickets |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | No | 0 | 6 | No | No |
| Summit Silver | Yes | 24 | 5 | No | No |
| Summit Gold | Yes | 72 | 4 | Yes | No |
| Summit Platinum | Yes | 72 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Diamond | Yes | 120 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Chairman | Yes | 120 | 1 | Yes | Yes |

**Points of reading**

1. The clearance window is counted in hours before the scheduled departure of the segment: a Summit Silver request can begin to clear 24 hours before departure, a Summit Diamond request 120 hours before.
2. The priority rank orders waitlisted requests: a rank of 1 clears before a rank of 2, and so on to 6.
3. Summit Member holds no complimentary upgrade entitlement; its window of 0 and rank of 6 carry no complimentary right.
4. Upgrades on award tickets, by complimentary request or certificate, are open from Summit Platinum upward.
